input: I want to pay my water bill
steps: panel → type → send; wait 60 s on landing page
expected: English reply, water page opens, page usable for an English reader

observed.message: Please continue on the "Water bill" page. It is a demo; nothing is submitted or paid. (The page is translated on your phone; some names may differ from the Chinese original.)
observed.ui: Whole App chrome switched to English (FAB 'Assistant', panel labels). Banner 'Downloading the page translation model (about 30 MB)…' for ~40 s, page stays Chinese meanwhile.
observed.translated_page: '1碼'→'1 yard', '超商'→'Superfocker', '即日起'→'Nowhere', '行動支付'→'Action payment', '檢核號'→'detection number'

note: Assistant part correct (reply language, navigation, disclaimer). But what an English-speaking resident actually reads is ML Kit on-device MT of the page, which is badly wrong on the key instructions ('The zone is 1 yard… the account number is 6 yards') and produces 'Superfocker'. The download banner text renders with Flutter's yellow double-underline debug style (TPText without a Material ancestor, lib/page/assistant/widget/assistant_host.dart:61-89) and sits over the page header/close button. Shots fe-11-en-*.png

input: 我要繳水費 → 取消 after ~3 s → immediately 我要借書
steps: send, tap 取消, send a new request right away
expected: new request is handled (or the UI explains a short wait)

observed.after_cancel: 已取消，未開啟新的頁面。
observed.retry_reply: 目前有一個需求正在處理，請稍後再試。

note: UI cancel only drops the reply client-side; the backend keeps computing the cancelled turn and rejects the user's next request with a vague 'a request is being processed' (the user just cancelled it, so this reads as a bug). The user must guess how long to wait (model turns take 30-50 s here). A retry ~1 min later worked. Shot fe-21-after-cancel-resend*.png

input: 我要借書 (tap where the hint was, ~8-10 s after the reply)
steps: after navigation wait until the hint has just disappeared and tap its spot
expected: nothing harmful / hint stays long enough

observed.result: hint already gone; tap landed on the library ranking list and opened the book 《底層邏輯》 detail page

note: The 8 s hint (assistant_view_controller _showCorner) vanishes while a slow reader is reaching for it, and the tap falls through to whatever is underneath — here it silently opened an unrelated book. Hint also first shows '正在開啟服務頁面…' and only then the reply, eating into the 8 s. Consider a longer timeout or keeping it until the user interacts.

input: (observed across all panel screenshots)

observed.panel: translucent white over the current page; page text (book titles, ISBN digits, red water-fee notice) visible between bubbles and choice cards
observed.reopen: opening via the 助理 FAB does not scroll to the newest message (fe-11-en-panel, fe-16-th-panel: newest turn below the fold); the hint tap does scroll to it
